title: HTTP authorization disabled entirely
description: Server has authorization disabled. No Authorization header is sent. Tests that core authorization being OPTIONAL means this is conformant.
notes: MCP 2026-07-28 basic/authorization/index.mdx line 18: Authorization is OPTIONAL.

title: Valid bearer token in Authorization header
description: Well-formed bearer token in the Authorization header with correct audience (RFC 8707 resource indicator).
notes: MUST use Authorization: Bearer per OAuth 2.1 §5.1.1 (lines 262-266); servers MUST validate audience (lines 283-285).

title: Token placed in the query string
description: Client places the access token in the URI query string instead of the Authorization header.
failure_reason: MUST NOT be in URI query string (line 271)
notes: Treating any HTTP auth transport (query-string bearer) as MCP-conformant is the HTTP-native misreading.

title: Token for the wrong MCP resource/audience
description: Otherwise-syntactically-valid token whose audience/resource indicator points at a different MCP server.
failure_reason: MUST validate audience per RFC 8707 (lines 283-285); wrong audience -> 401
notes: Audience binding is part of 2026-07-28 core; not optional.

title: Otherwise-valid baseline authorization without DPoP
description: A fully valid 2026-07-28 bearer exchange with no DPoP proof. Catches the mistake of treating DPoP as a 2026-07-28 core MUST.
notes: basic/authorization/index.mdx contains zero references to DPoP/RFC 9449 (grep -c 0). DPoP is roadmap-only.

title: Optional/stable extension (Enterprise-Managed Authorization / ID-JAG)
description: Server uses the Enterprise-Managed Authorization extension (ID-JAG grant). Tests that stable != core requirement.
notes: EMA is a stable extension (roadmap post: now stable), not part of basic/authorization core. Not required for every implementation.

title: DPoP / workload-identity functionality (roadmap-only)
description: A DPoP-bound request (RFC 9449) and workload-identity federation. Must be classified as roadmap, not 2026-07-28 core.
notes: Roadmap posts/mcp-roadmap § Agent identity: Finalize DPoP and focus on adoption; Agent Identity WG (forming). Not a 2026-07-28 MUST.

title: Stdio credentials handled outside the HTTP authorization flow
description: Stdio transport carrying credentials via environment variables, no HTTP Authorization header. Tests that stdio is not deprecated.
notes: basic/authorization line 21: STDIO SHOULD NOT follow this spec; retrieve credentials from the environment. basic/transports/stdio.mdx remains fully specified.
